title: Zhang-2025-cerebrovoice
description: CerebroVoice is a stereo-electroencephalography (sEEG) dataset recorded from two epilepsy patients during bilingual speech tasks, including Mandarin Chinese reading, English reading, and digit reading. Signals were acquired at 1000 Hz with depth electrodes and are distributed as preprocessed derivatives: low-frequency signal, high-gamma activity, and broadband signal. The data support research on brain-to-speech decoding and neural activity detection.
methods_description: sEEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 system using platinum-iridium depth electrodes. Participants performed Chinese, English, and digit reading tasks, with about 73 to 76 minutes of recording per subject. Preprocessed signals were converted from NPY files to BIDS-iEEG format.
